# Elizabetta

> > Elizabetta is a luxury Italian accessories boutique specializing in handmade silk scarves, ties, and shawls crafted in Como, Italy.

The boutique offers premium Italian-made accessories including silk and wool scarves, neckties, neckerchiefs, and evening shawls. Each piece is handcrafted using traditional techniques from Como, Italy's renowned silk-producing region, featuring distinctive patterns from classic paisleys to equestrian prints and Tiffany glass-inspired designs.
